credits.title: A Story She Told
credits.overview: The return of an old love quietly fractures a filmmaker's celebratory night, as a private past begins to reveal itself in the story she chose to tell.

credits.overview: Seeking a fresh start, chef Xu Fu travels to the Middle East to support his family and repay his debts. Alongside restaurant manager Ma Junsheng, he transforms the struggling Dragon Restaurant into a thriving business. credits.title: Blasphemy
credits.overview: Alek discovers that the power of prayer is extremely volatile.

credits.title: Orange Cove
credits.overview: Craig hires film restoration artist Gracey to restore precious footage shot at his late grandparents' ranch. When Craig begins recounting increasingly bizarre and violent encounters with Gracey to his coworkers and friends, those around him start to question what's really happening.

credits.title: Shark Terror
credits.overview: After falling overboard during a cruise, a young woman washes ashore – injured, stranded, and stalked by sharks – as her desperate mother races to find her.

credits.title: Blood Star
credits.overview: A young woman is driving through the desert alone when she is drawn into a dangerous game of cat and mouse with a psychopathic Sheriff. The chase escalates to deadly levels, and she must use her street-smarts to turn the tables against him.

credits.title: Cactus Juice
credits.overview: After getting lost looking for a skinwalker, two guys have a strange encounter with a hippie that may just lead the skinwalker right to them.

credits.title: Straight On till Morning
credits.overview: Dani and Kaitlin are two dreamers falling for each other on a romantic roadtrip. The world is theirs -- until they cross paths with a family that has something much, much darker in mind. Be afraid.

credits.title: Washerwoman
credits.overview: A pregnant woman alone in the wilderness must make it through the forest inhabited by a Banshee.

credits.title: The Pastor and the Pro
credits.overview: A young, single pastor needs a date for a church dinner, so he hires his neighbor next door, who works as a prostitute, to accompany him. credits.title: Ice Sharks
credits.overview: A new breed of aggressive, ravenous sharks cracks the frozen ocean floor of an Arctic research station, devouring all who fall through. As the station sinks into frigid waters, those alive must fashion makeshift weapons or suffer the same fate.

credits.title: Back to Awesome
credits.overview: During an internship in Tahoe, an awkward motormouth college sophomore is determined to fit in with his cool post-collegiate roommates, but discovers they, just like himself, are all major works in progress.

credits.title: The Gunfighter
credits.overview: In the tradition of classic westerns, a narrator sets up the story of a lone gunslinger who walks into a saloon. However, the people in this saloon can hear the narrator and the narrator may just be a little bit bloodthirsty.

credits.title: Beauty and the Least
credits.overview: When they say “love is blind” they must have been talking about Amy and Ben. Amy is a beautiful young woman with a mysterious past.
